bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
u=gace-userbot-verify.service
r=/home/gace/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot
test "$(systemctl --user is-active "$u")" = active || exit 70
test "$(systemctl --user is-enabled "$u")" = enabled || exit 71
test -S "$r/deploy/secrets/userbot_verify.sock" || exit 72
docker inspect deploy-gaybbs-1 --format 'GAYBBS_RUNNING={{.State.Running}} RESTARTS={{.RestartCount}}'
docker exec deploy-gaybbs-1 sh -c 'test "$GAYBBS_ROOM_EVENT_WORKER_ENABLED" = enabled && test "$GAYBBS_ROOM_STATUS_EDIT_ENABLED" = enabled' || exit 73
docker exec deploy-postgres-1 psql -X -U gace -d gaybbs -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -At -F '|' -c "SELECT 'EVENT',kind,state,count(*) FROM room_source_events GROUP BY kind,state ORDER BY kind,state" || exit 74
docker exec deploy-postgres-1 psql -X -U gace -d gaybbs -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -At -F '|' -c "SELECT 'PUBLIC_EDIT',e.kind,q.state,count(*) FROM room_status_message_edits q JOIN room_source_events e ON e.event_id=q.room_event_id GROUP BY e.kind,q.state ORDER BY e.kind,q.state" || exit 75
docker exec deploy-postgres-1 psql -X -U gace -d gaybbs -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -At -F '|' -c "SELECT 'CARD_STATUS',r.status,CASE WHEN d.rendered_text LIKE '%✅ 終了%' THEN 'FINISHED_MARK' WHEN d.rendered_text LIKE '%🔴 LIVE中%' THEN 'LIVE_MARK' ELSE 'OTHER' END,count(*) FROM posting_deliveries d JOIN announcement_posts a ON a.announcement_id::text=d.source_id JOIN room_posts r ON r.room_id=a.room_id WHERE d.source_type='announcement' AND d.status='sent' AND d.telegram_message_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY r.status,2 ORDER BY r.status,2" || exit 76
docker logs --since 5m deploy-gaybbs-1 2>&1 | grep 'GAYBBS_WORKER_CHECK_FAILED' | sed -E 's/ .*$/ REDACTED/' | sort | uniq -c || :
echo ROOM_PUBLIC_SYNC_RUNTIME_READBACK_PASS
